The Bridges Coordinator is responsible for the comprehensive coordination and oversight of newborn family screening and risk assessment within the assigned facility, utilizing the Bridges Maternal Child Health Screening Tool to identify families who may benefit from additional support services. The incumbent maintains accountability for the completion of prescreening, eligibility determination, and timely referral to enhanced services, including home visitation programs and CalWORKs Home Visiting Program, ensuring all documentation and data entry meets program timelines and data integrity standards. This role provides non-clinical bedside education and support to postpartum families, addressing available community resources for breastfeeding, immunizations, newborn care and postpartum wellbeing, while identifying and facilitating referrals for families with social, developmental, behavioral health, or psychosocial risk factors. The Coordinator manages inventory and distribution of educational materials and Kits for New Parents, ensures compliance with data privacy, HIPAA, consent, and information-sharing requirements, and serves as the hospital’s liaison with First 5 Orange County / Bridges program leadership, participating in meetings, audits, training, and program improvement initiatives. The incumbent collaborates closely with nursing, case management, social work, physicians, lactation consultants, and community partners to support seamless care transitions, educates hospital coworkers on program workflows and resources, and monitors program performance metrics to ensure contract compliance and successful achievement of outcomes. This position exercises independent judgment in integrating screening and referral processes into routine, non-clinical maternal-child operations and supports regulatory compliance activities as needed.
